# shc_backup (Resource)

Manages a backup of an SHC VPS.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (String) The SHC service ID of the VPS to back up.

### Optional

- `name` (String) A name for the backup.
- `restore` (Boolean) When true, triggers a one-shot restore of the VM from this backup on the next apply. Resets to false after the restore completes.

### Read-Only

- `backup_id` (String) The ID of the created backup.
- `status` (String) The status of the backup.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "shc_vm" "app" {
  hostname = "app"
  size     = "nvme-1c-4gb"
  template = "debian12-cloud"
}

resource "shc_backup" "weekly" {
  service_id = shc_vm.app.service_id
  name       = "weekly-backup"
}
```
